evidence.excerpt_or_description: The dimensioned drawing shows the curved horn volume and its transition to the WR90 waveguide aperture.
The curve horn is exponentially fitted to WR90 dimensions and has external walls 5.5 mm thick.

expected.summary: Represent the horn and WR90 transition as source-backed volumetric geometry with the reported taper.
expected.acceptable_alternative: Mark the exponential profile unresolved and reconstruction-blocking if Figure 1 does not fully define it.
expected.forbidden_condition: Replacing the horn with a generic box or unsupported linear taper.

assertions.review_instruction: Compare the reconstructed horn, waveguide transition, wall thickness, and taper profile with Figure 1.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: Three ABS horns are coated with silver conductive paint, copper tape, and copper plated metallization; a fourth aluminum horn is the conventional comparison.
Separate subfigures identify silver paint, copper tape, and copper plated horn variants.

expected.summary: Keep ABS/coating combinations and the aluminum comparison as distinct design variants.
expected.forbidden_condition: Merging coating or substrate materials across variants.

assertions.review_instruction: Verify separate material records and design references for all four fabricated variants.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: Measured S11 curves compare the separately named horn variants.
Copper-plated and aluminum horns are reported between 14.7 dB and 17.7 dB, copper tape between 10.9 dB and 14.7 dB, and silver paint between 8.2 dB and 13.2 dB.

expected.summary: Associate every S11, gain, pattern, and weight result with the correct horn variant.
expected.forbidden_condition: Assigning a copper-plated or aluminum gain range to the silver-painted horn.

assertions.review_instruction: Trace each result to its curve, text label, or Table I row and confirm its design reference.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The figure is the source for horn dimensions.
The source identifies coating products and reports copper-tape total thickness 0.076 mm.

expected.summary: Preserve reported dimensions, ABS body material, and coating identities without unsupported substitutions.
expected.forbidden_condition: Inventing conductivity, thickness, or alloy for a variant when not reported.

verifiable_condition.expected_text: reported dimensions and materials retain source evidence

evidence.excerpt_or_description: Measurements use an HP X281A coaxial WR90 adapter for all antennas.
S11 is measured with an Anritsu MS4644B vector network analyzer.

expected.summary: Identify the reported S11, gain, and radiation-pattern results as measured where the source does so.
